title: inbox notes carry a motion picture (manual until automated)

clauses.text: A motion note can carry the event's picture, shown small at the left of the note's words.

steps.do: Turn on the setting that lets thumbnails travel with notices, then make the camera see motion in front of it.
steps.expect: The Inbox shows a small picture at the left of the note's words.

clauses.text: A note without a picture looks as it did before.

steps.do: Look at an Inbox note that has no picture.
steps.expect: It shows its words only, as before.
